title: Christmas Magic in Philadelphia with Shoofly & Cookie
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Philadelphia at your own pace on a fully private Christmas tour. Walk through the city’s historic streets and stop by Christ Church, followed by a visit to the Liberty Bell, where you learn about its national significance. Continue to the Made in Philadelphia Holiday Market to browse locally crafted gifts and seasonal items. Your tour then leads to the Christmas Village, known for its festive atmosphere, decorated stalls, and traditional holiday flavors. During the tour, you will also enjoy a Shoofly Bite & Holiday Cookie, a classic Pennsylvania Dutch, inspired treat that adds a local food experience to your Christmas visit in Philadelphia.
